Method of Attack: Hides malicious files on removable USB devices to infect Windows hosts
Uses Unicode whitespace character to create hidden directories on USB drives invisible on Windows Explorer
Creates Windows shortcut (.lnk) files on USB root to execute malware
Side-loads encrypted payloads via poisoned DLL (x32bridge.dll) and debugging tool (x64dbg.exe)
Copies sensitive documents (PDF, Microsoft Word) to hidden folders on USB drives
Monitors for new USB devices to infect them upon discovery
Attack Vector: Side-loading via poisoned DLL and debugging tool
Indicators of Compromise: Hidden directories with Unicode whitespace characters on USB drives
Shortcut (.lnk) files on USB root folder
Presence of files: x32bridge.dll, x64dbg.exe, x32bridge.dat, desktop.ini, RECYCLER.BIN folder
Hidden folder named da520e5 containing copied documents
Low detection rates on VirusTotal scanning platform
